title: Leading Tracks that are making waves in the music scene today
htmlContent:
Music can be many things for a lot of different people. For some people, it's a vibe. For some, it's therapy or an escape from this world to another. All are good things, but for those who need that thought-provoking music that's instantly engaging, then it's a must you don't go another minute without hearing the new tracks from these talented lyrical geniuses.

Their performance is on another plateau, as they command your attention with their unique styles that flex an extreme amount of bravado and charisma, which easily carry their tracks to their dopest destination. 

Here is the list of songs that you must hear this week:

  • Jonathan Eagle - New City, New Me

In his recent song "New City, New Me," Jonathan Eagle talks about how he felt after moving away from home and figuring out what to do to cope with that and self-doubt. The artist's talents are on full display ranging from incredible vocal performance to fantastic songwriting.

For more, stay connected to Jonathan Eagle below:

Instagram 

  • Amaya Santos - Better

Amaya Santos is a fast-rising R&B singer and songwriter who captivates her fans and the music industry with her powerhouse vocals, impeccable lyricism, and genre-blending sound. Amaya Santos's "Better" is a track that speaks to the heart of anyone who has gone through a situation where they are better off without someone who is not bringing anything positive to their life. The incredible sound shows us her songwriting to the fullest as she crafts together her unique sound that stands out from the crowd.

For more, stay connected to Amaya Santos below:

Instagram | Tik-Tok

  • Nicki Knightz - Along Came Molly

Nicki Knightz, on her recent track "Along Came Molly," talks plainly about the generation we are in and how they use substances to escape reality. She takes us on a journey as she opens up about her euphoric experience with an illegal substance, the lows, and the highs, all of which flow beneath a bed of experimental bliss. 

For more, stay connected to Nicki Knightz  below:

Instagram | Tik-Tok

  • Con The Artist - All My Friends

CON THE ARTIST is no stranger to the music scene. Hailing from South Africa, Con The Artist is a multi-talented hip-hop star who has been solidifying his name in the background through every release. In his recent track, "All My Friends," Con The Artist talks about loss and nostalgia disguised as a catchy pop anthem that will get stuck in your head.

For more, stay connected Con The Artist below:

Instagram | Tik-Tok | Facebook

  • DK Verano - Better Know Now

Dk Verano is a multi-talented singer and lyrical genius poised to continue his rise to the top of the music scene with the release of his recent track "Better Know Now." Dk Verano's "Better Know Now" is a hyped-up high-energy track for listeners to get amped by. The music star manages to take us on a journey and can make a modern-day classic with endless vibes to rock to.
